note: `.faces("<X").workplane(offset=2.5).moveTo(1, 1).circle(1).extrude(1)`. `<X` is the plane x = -2 with normal -x, x axis -y, y axis +z, so the offset puts it at x = -4.5 and (1, 1) at (y, z) = (-1, 1); the cylinder (r = 1) goes on along -x to x = -5.5: a second piece, V = 192 + pi, A = 208 + 4 pi, centroid (-5 pi, -pi, pi) / V.
